proves.claim: next --no-wait with nothing for the seat prints the IDLE_TIMEOUT line and exits 4 at once, a held review still refuses REVIEW_HELD, and plain next is unchanged.

cli.io-commands-next.no-wait-idle-exit-4.why: Without it a script or probe that must not wait cannot tell an idle board from a finished one.

proves.claim: next --no-wait returns the board-finished line with exit 3 only when every item in the seat lane is verified and at least one was filed.

cli.io-commands-next.no-wait-finished-ex.why: Without it a seat cannot learn that its lane is done and keeps asking, or stops while work remains.
